split.decision: Archived accepted observation/reference pairs; stratified by n, original replicates 1-5 public validation and 6-10 private test. All 50 archived cases retained, 25 per split, five cases per original n/d setting. No new HMC or generated labels.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical full-archive S-LAP standardized bias 0.0384313608672964; no full conversion reference measured.

allowed_changes: Posterior approximation family, numerical sampling/integration, auxiliary approximation loss, optimizer, reparameterization and implementation may change while targeting that posterior.
Skew-symmetric Laplace and its proposal/kernel settings are baseline methods.
When retaining the supplied skew-symmetric Laplace estimator, changing only the 10,000 Gaussian proposal count does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Approximate posterior means for the fixed Poisson regression/Student-t(3) posterior under the existing posterior-evaluation budget.
The Poisson likelihood/link, independent Student-t(3) coefficient priors, observed X/y, coordinates and posterior-mean functional remain fixed.
The HMC coordinate reference, standardized absolute bias then coordinate median/cell mean, 21500 actual posterior-evaluation cap and zero-reference-access rule remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not change likelihood, prior/scale, posterior temperature or coordinates, optimize predictive fit instead of the requested posterior mean, or use reference summaries during fitting.
No fabricated posterior-call telemetry, cached outputs, cross-instance fitting or changed fallback/metric.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

21500 reflects reviewed full baseline call count; computational budget is scientific cost, not a wall-clock gate.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
